crossRefs.note: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment…

translations.web: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.
translations.bsb: So when they came here with me, I did not delay. The next day I sat on the judgment seat and ordered that the man be brought in.
translations.kjv: Therefore, when they were come hither, without any delay on the morrow I sat on the judgment seat, and commanded the man to be brought forth.
translations.asv: When therefore they were come together here, I made no delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment-seat, and commanded the man to be brought.
